subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK enforce a hard 16 MiB request-body cap and 30 second read timeout for the BYOK proxy request contract?
rationale: The code shape is correct, but automation cannot know the maximum legitimate Copilot BYOK SDK/provider request size that maintainers want to support before this path ships.

options.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
options.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended Copilot BYOK proxy envelope and merge with the shared limiter and regression test.

options.title: Tune the envelope before merge
options.body: Change the size or timeout constants if maintainers expect valid BYOK workloads above this envelope while keeping the limiter shape.

options.title: Pause for payload confirmation
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers verify expected Copilot BYOK request sizes and timeout behavior against representative providers.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
recommendation.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended Copilot BYOK proxy envelope and merge with the shared limiter and regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the Copilot BYOK proxy and provider bridge, making them the clearest owner for the request-envelope contract choice.
